entries.source:
A broad sword with a blade length of
around 70cm. There's nothing particularly special
about it, but that means that anyone can wield it.
entries.translation:
剑刃长约70厘米的阔剑。
虽然没有什么特别之处，
但也因此人人都能使用。
entries.previous_translation:
一把长着刀的剑
周围 70页: 1 没什么特别的
但这意味着任何人都可以发挥它。

A sword with a blade nearly 1m. long. If you can
swing this well you're a real warrior.

剑刃长近1米的剑。
能熟练挥舞它的人，才称得上真正的战士。
entries.previous_translation:
一把剑,一把刀几乎 1缩略语 长。 如果可以的话
挥手吧 你是个真正的战士

仅在白天生效：\c[61]ACC\c[0] \c[60]+20%\c[0]，\c[61]暴击率\c[0] \c[60]+100%\c[0]。

entries.source:
"I have a new song about incredible hunger. 
 Allow me." The sound of his lute and his
 voice brighten the area around him. His
 music boosts the stamina of the listener.

 Even if you're not as gifted as the bard,
 you can use a \c[65]Music Box\c[0]
 to raise morale.

 But there is no one to audience him, and 
 the music fades into the air. Singing only 
 made him hungrier.
entries.translation:
“我新作了一首描写饥肠辘辘的歌。
请容我献唱。”他的鲁特琴声与歌声
让四周焕发光彩。他的
音乐能够提升听众的耐力。

即使没有吟游诗人那样的天赋，
你也可以使用\c[65]音乐盒\c[0]
来提振士气。

然而，他身边没有一个听众，
乐声就这样消散在空气中。
唱完这一曲，他反而更饿了。
